statement:
by
  classical
  exact let I := fun n : ℕ => Finset.Icc ((n+2)/3) ((2*n)/3); let P := fun z : ℕ => (Finset.Icc 2 z).filter Nat.Prime; let V := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).card:ℝ)*(n.totient:ℝ)/n * ∏ p ∈ (P z).filter (fun p => ¬ p ∣ n), (1-2/(p:ℝ)); let S := fun n z : ℕ => ((I n).filter (fun u => u.Coprime n ∧ z < (u*(n-u)).minFac)).card; let Z₁ := fun n : ℕ => ⌊(n:ℝ)^(1/3:ℝ)⌋₊; let K : ℝ := (Real.exp Real.eulerMascheroniConstant*(1+Real.log 2)/3)^2; ∀ ε : ℝ, 0 < ε → ∃ T : ℕ, ∀ X H : ℕ, T ≤ X → X ≤ H^2 → H ≤ X → let D := (Finset.Icc X (X+H)).filter Even; (∑ n ∈ D, ((S n (Z₁ n):ℝ)/V n (Z₁ n)-K)^2) ≤ ε*(D.card:ℝ)

plain_statement.zh: 在每个长度至少 √X 的目标窗口，证明立方根粗糙数对模型的均方误差趋零。
plain_statement.en: Vanishing mean-square discrepancy for reflected rough pairs in every square-root-length target window.

brief.zh: 这是逐偶数极限的可独立推进的弱化，仍须超越 Kai Fan（arXiv:2306.03347）的单坐标估计。展开平方会得到两对反射拆分的相关和；用 n 自己的 V 和移动筛点再做窗口平均。小均方误差可控制窗口中未达到旧筛下界的目标比例。
brief.en: A mesoscopic intermediate goal for #3819. Expand the square into two reflected pairs, retaining the moving sieve cutoff and each target’s local normalization. Fan’s single-coordinate estimate does not control this four-variable correlation.
